actions.title: confirm the private boundary
actions.instruction: Read the Preview 0.17 limits. U05 is private source material, so the installed Academy tool refuses every U05 lifecycle command.
actions.rationale: A source guide must not imply that an unpublished lab is runnable.
actions.expected_result: You know Preview 0.17 cannot create or evaluate a U05 attempt. Next safe step: observe the refusal or use a published lab.
actions.recovery: Use a published lab instead; never edit publication data to bypass this refusal.
actions.evidence: Preview manifest exclusion and the refusal output.

actions.title: observe Prepare refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Prepare command only to confirm the public boundary.
actions.rationale: Prepare must fail closed until U05 is accepted and published.
actions.expected_result: Preview reports U05 is not published or guided and creates no attempt. Next safe step: stop at the published boundary.
actions.recovery: Preserve the refusal; do not create scenario evidence by hand.
actions.evidence: Nonzero refusal and unchanged git status.

actions.title: read the prepared cache-key observation
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: in the prepared Academy attempt, read docs/U05-cache-key-observation.md before invoking a host command. Treat it as a fictional Academy input, never as command output.
actions.rationale: The precise observation makes the debug question reproducible without inventing a debug transcript.
actions.expected_result: You can state the observed behavior, reproduction boundary, expected no-action disposition, and spike question. Next safe step: run host-native debug.
actions.recovery: If the observation is absent or differs from the prepared fixture, stop and preserve the attempt; do not rewrite it.
actions.evidence: The committed prepared docs/U05-cache-key-observation.md file, with no debug.note receipt in it.

actions.title: run debug without code changes
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: run the host-native debug command on the prepared cache-key observation and take its no-action exit. Do not write a debug report or modify product code.
actions.rationale: $ca-debug owns the investigation and, for its real no-action exit, writes the board only through taskwrite.py.
actions.expected_result: The actual no-action exit queues one cited debug.note.0001 entry with Desc: and makes no code change. Next safe step: review only the board diff.
actions.recovery: If the diagnosis selects fix or ADR, stop; this bounded exercise requires the declared no-action exit.
actions.evidence: An unstaged taskwrite-shaped .codearbiter/open-tasks.md debug.note.0001 entry, not a transcript.

actions.title: review the debug-board boundary
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: inspect the board diff and confirm it contains only the no-action debug.note entry with its Desc: continuation.
actions.rationale: The board is durable plugin output; a review prevents unrelated changes from being committed as debug evidence.
actions.expected_result: The only intended diff is the cited debug.note board entry and git diff --check is silent. Next safe step: commit the board through the host.
actions.recovery: If other paths or a free-form bullet appear, stop and preserve the diff; do not edit a receipt to imitate taskwrite.

actions.title: commit the no-action board entry
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: use the host-native commit gate to commit the reviewed debug board entry by itself.
actions.rationale: $ca-commit is the sanctioned commit path and keeps the debug close distinct from the later spike finding.
actions.expected_result: One clean parent-branch commit changes only .codearbiter/open-tasks.md. Next safe step: run the disposable spike.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its findings and resolve them; do not fold the board entry into the findings commit.
actions.evidence: A committed debug-note board change and a clean worktree.

actions.title: run the disposable spike
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: use the host-native spike command with the fixture question U05 cache key. It requires a matching released integration: CodeArbiter 2.15.1 (Claude); ca-codex 0.7.1 (Codex); or ca-pi 0.8.1 (Pi), each carrying the findings-only spike contract from PR 687. Work only on spike/u05-cache-key and commit only its findings file there.
actions.rationale: $ca-spike deliberately burns implementation while preserving a bounded answer.
actions.expected_result: The host restates the bounded U05 cache-key question and pauses before creating spike/u05-cache-key. Next safe step: confirm that exact question.
actions.recovery: If code, a merge, or a pull request is proposed, stop; a spike has no implementation, merge, or PR exit.
actions.evidence: The confirmation prompt is transient. The only durable spike evidence is the committed findings file later restored to the parent; the spike branch itself must be absent at Check.

actions.title: confirm the spike question
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: when the host restates U05 cache key and asks for confirmation, confirm only if it is the bounded, falsifiable fixture question and the branch is spike/u05-cache-key.
actions.rationale: $ca-spike must stop for user confirmation before it creates the disposable branch or explores.
actions.expected_result: The confirmed host flow creates spike/u05-cache-key, explores only there, and on its answered exit commits only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md. Next safe step: restore only that findings file to the parent.
actions.recovery: If the question, branch, or timebox differs, decline and correct the prompt; do not let a spike start from an unconfirmed or broadened question.
actions.evidence: The confirmed interactive prompt is not Check evidence; the later findings-only commit and absent branch are observable evidence.

actions.title: restore only the committed findings
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: return to the Academy attempt branch and restore only the committed finding from spike/u05-cache-key. This is a native Git transfer, not a merge.
actions.rationale: The released spike contract permits the finding’s contents to cross back but forbids the spike commit and exploratory code.
actions.expected_result: Only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md is now unstaged on the parent branch. Next safe step: review that one-file diff.
actions.recovery: If Git reports the spike ref is unavailable, preserve the state and stop; do not recreate findings or copy any spike code by hand.
actions.evidence: An unstaged parent diff limited to the one findings file.

actions.title: review the findings-only transfer
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: inspect the parent diff and stage exactly .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md, then inspect the cached diff before committing.
actions.rationale: Staging and cached-diff review make the one-file transfer boundary visible before the commit gate runs.

variants.command:
git add -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md
git diff --cached --name-only
git diff --cached -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md

git add -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md
git diff --cached --name-only
git diff --cached -- .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md

actions.expected_result: The cached path list contains only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md, with all four findings headings. Next safe step: commit the parent transfer through the host.
actions.recovery: If any code or extra path is staged, unstage it and preserve the evidence; do not use a broad add command.
actions.evidence: Cached diff and path list for exactly the one findings file.

actions.title: commit the parent findings transfer
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: use the host-native commit gate to commit the reviewed parent findings transfer by itself.
actions.rationale: The parent commit is distinct from the disposable spike commit and preserves only the answer.
actions.expected_result: A second clean parent-branch commit changes only .codearbiter/spikes/u05-cache-key.md. Next safe step: delete the disposable branch.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, keep the parent and spike state intact until its finding is resolved; do not merge the spike branch.
actions.evidence: A clean parent worktree and a distinct one-file findings commit.

actions.title: delete the unmerged disposable branch
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: after the parent findings commit is clean, delete the intentionally unmerged disposable spike branch. Force deletion is required because the findings-only restore did not merge its commit.
actions.rationale: The branch is disposable by contract, and Git correctly treats its unmerged exploratory commit as not merged.
actions.expected_result: refs/heads/spike/u05-cache-key is absent while the committed parent findings file remains. Next safe step: halt for any conflict or run Check when published.
actions.recovery: If the branch still contains unreviewed findings, stop before deletion; never merge it merely to make ordinary branch deletion succeed.
actions.evidence: Absent U05 spike ref and retained parent findings commit.

actions.title: honor the conflict stop
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: when conflicting rules appear, use $ca-conflict to present exact sources and wait for the user's resolution before any further work.
actions.rationale: Conflict is a human decision protocol, not an artifact generator.
actions.expected_result: Work remains stopped until the person resolves the hierarchy conflict. Next safe step: resume only from the explicit resolution.
actions.recovery: Do not paraphrase a resolution or continue speculatively; present the actual sources and wait.
actions.evidence: Human acknowledgement is outside automated Check; no fake conflict receipt exists.

actions.title: observe Check refusal
actions.instruction: Run one installed Academy Check command only to confirm the current public boundary.
actions.rationale: The public verifier must not claim acceptance for an unpublished private contract.
actions.expected_result: Preview reports U05 is not published or guided and does not modify the repository. Next safe step: return to a published lab.
actions.recovery: Return to a published lab; do not manufacture evidence to force a result.
